summary: UI test (ProjectUITests.testProjectDiffPillOpensGitDiffPane) drives a real git repo and asserts branch/file/added/deleted content actually renders after clicking the project-specific diffPill; unit test (testShowPendingChangesOpensProjectReviewWithoutChangingSelectedConversation) uses two distinct projects to confirm the summary shown is tied to the clicked project's ID/path, not the currently-selected one. No mocking of the git-status rendering path, no tautological or keyword-only assertions found.
